newsitem.title: UK: BICC FALLS ON GLOOMY PRESS COMMENT.
newsitem.headline: BICC FALLS ON GLOOMY PRESS COMMENT.

text.p: Shares in British cable to construction group BICC Plc dropped on Thursday after a raft of negative press comments weighed on the shares, dealers said.
BICC shares fell 7-1/2p to 155p by 0907 GMT in volume of 281,000 shares.

Following the publication of BICC's half-year figures on Wednesday, British daily newspapers highlighted the disappointing performance of the company's cables division and said the shares were likely to remain under a cloud in the short-term.
BICC made pre-tax profits of 55 million stg in the six months to June 28 1997, compared to a two million stg post-exceptional loss a year ago.
However, the company warned that some of its businesses still faced difficult conditions and planned to further reduce its exposure to German and Italian power cables.
